description: A floor-length deep blue wool noble gown with low square neckline and opaque fitted bodice, narrow gold-and-cream geometric woven borders along the shoulders, neckline, front panels, cuffs and hem. A cream shift shows at the lower front opening. A blue-and-gold woven sash and decorated belt hold the waist, with long tasseled ends. Round gold-toned brooches fasten the shoulders. A blue fur-edged wrap rests around the forearms, and dark brown leather shoes show below the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
